name: B3A medium (PMC2906461)
description: B3A medium — medium reported in PMC2906461, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC2906461 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: "B3A medium contained (per liter) 3 g NaCl, 0.5 g MgCl2·6H2O, 1 g NH4Cl, 0.1 g KCl, 2 g 3-(n-morpholino)propanesulfonic acid (MOPS), and 0.2 mg resazurine added to milli-Q water." coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
